notes: Placement rules: one classical reading per rising sign, ascendant-lord house, Moon sign and Moon star. Same schema as references.json.

Kept out of references.json on purpose: retrieval there is by domain, so the Ask assembler would hand a personality question all 56 placements, most of them for other charts. These are only ever picked for the placement a chart actually has (agents/story_classics.py).

Read from the books on 2026-10-28: BPHS ch.4 and ch.26 (Sharma trans., OCR export), Brihat Jataka ch.XVI and ch.XVII (Suryanarain Rao trans., OCR export). statement is a paraphrase, never copied translation text; only character and life-direction parts of each verse are carried.

references.statement: Aries rising: a movable, male (krura) sign ruled by Mars, with Rajas predominant. Movable signs incline a person to be active and practical rather than reflective, quick to take offence but quick to let it go; a male sign rising gives an assertive, outgoing bearing.

source.location: ch.4 v.5 and v.6-7, nature of the signs (Sharma trans.)

references.observance_note: The verses classify each sign (movable, fixed or dual; male or female; its guna where the translation states one). What each class means for temperament is the translator's note to v.5, carried as the standard reading; the dual-sign line follows that note's logic.

references.statement: Taurus rising: a fixed, female (saumya) sign ruled by Venus, with Rajas predominant. Fixed signs incline a person to be reflective and steady rather than restless, slow to take offence but slow to let it go; a female sign rising gives gentleness, grace and a yielding nature.
